errors.text: The proposed HPHT treatment is unrelated to the target intervention of varying tensile crystallographic orientation, temperature, and strain rate in a single-crystal FCC FeNiCrMn model.

The claimed hierarchical multiphase microstructure and coherent interfaces are not established for HPHT-treated equiatomic FeNiCrMn and conflict with the target partial-dislocation and stacking-fault mechanism.
The prediction of doubling both strength and ductility has no cited supporting evidence.
The proposed validity range of 300–1000 K and 10^-4–10^8 s^-1 is unsupported and does not match the target range of 10–600 K and 10^8–10^10 s^-1.
The falsification experiment is quasi-static and room-temperature only, so it cannot test behavior across dynamic strain rates, temperatures, or crystallographic orientations.
